site.name: ShyTalk
site.tagline: Learn languages and cultures by talking.

home.title: ShyTalk
home.heading: Learn languages and cultures by talking
home.intro: ShyTalk is a friendly place to practise a language out loud and discover the cultures behind it.
home.paceBody: Join a voice room, listen in, and take a seat to speak when you feel ready. Shy is welcome here.
home.peopleTitle: Learn from the people who live it.
home.peopleBody: Hear how a language is really spoken, and learn the customs, festivals and everyday life that come with it.
home.safeBody: Clear community rules keep ShyTalk supportive, and moderators enforce them. Under-18s and adults use separate spaces.
home.wayBody: The ShyTalk app is being built now. Apply for closed testing to try it early.

closedTesting.heading: Apply for closed testing
closedTesting.intro: Closed testing lets a small group try the ShyTalk app before it launches.
closedTesting.noAccess: Sending this form does not give access to closed testing.
closedTesting.moreDetails: If you are preliminarily selected, you will be asked for more details.
closedTesting.safeList: Add support@shytalk.app to your safe list so that messages reach you.
closedTesting.removed: If you are not selected, your details are removed.
closedTesting.retention: Your details are kept only until closed testing ends.
closedTesting.adultLabel: Tick to confirm you are 18 or older
closedTesting.sent: Thank you. If this address still needs confirming, an email with a link is on its way.
closedTesting.invalid: Enter a valid email address and confirm you are 18 or older.
closedTesting.sendFailed: The email could not be sent. Please try again later.
closedTesting.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
closedTesting.noScript: This form needs JavaScript to be turned on.
closedTesting.confirmBody: Press the button to confirm this email address for closed testing.
closedTesting.confirmFailed: The email address could not be confirmed just now. Please try again later.
closedTesting.confirmedBody: Thank you. Your address is on the closed testing list.
closedTesting.expiredBody: This link has already been used or is more than 48 hours old.
closedTesting.mailSubject: Confirm your email for ShyTalk closed testing
closedTesting.mailIntro: Someone applied for ShyTalk closed testing with this address. To confirm it, open this link and press the button within 48 hours:
closedTesting.mailIgnore: If this was not you, ignore this email and the address is removed after 48 hours.
